recap: Cavaliers beat the Clippers 120–111 in overtime.
Evan Mobley led the Cavaliers with 30 points (13-22 FG, 1-3 3PT), 6 rebounds and 1 assists.
Ivica Zubac led the Clippers with 24 points (10-15 FG), 14 rebounds and 4 assists.
CLE won 3 of 4 factors: shooting, second chances, getting to the line. Effective FG% 56.4 to 50.0.
Biggest swing: Darius Garland makes 29-foot three point step back jump shot (Q4 1:20), +22 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): LeVert, Markkanen, Garland, Okoro, Mobley, +7 in 15:05.
Bench points: CLE 24, LAC 30. Points in the paint: 50–54. Second-chance points: 15–19.
